description: .NET version upgrade plan from net6.0 to net10.0 (latest LTS)

tasks.description: Upgrade ContosoUniversity to net10.0: update TargetFramework, upgrade 4 NuGet packages, and fix API incompatibilities in Program.cs
tasks.reason: ContosoUniversity currently targets net6.0 which reached end-of-life. Upgrading to net10.0 (latest LTS) ensures long-term support, access to performance improvements, and eliminates outdated package dependencies.
tasks.requirements: 1. In ContosoUniversity/ContosoUniversity.csproj: change TargetFramework from net6.0 to net10.0. 2. Update all 4 package references: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore 6.0.2 → 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 6.0.2 → 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools 6.0.2 → 10.0.5, Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design 6.0.2 → 10.0.2. 3. In ContosoUniversity/Program.cs: fix or remove source-incompatible calls at line 10 (AddDatabaseDeveloperPageExceptionFilter) and line 24 (UseMigrationsEndPoint) if they fail to compile after the package upgrade to 10.0.5; address the behavioral change at line 17 (UseExceptionHandler) by ensuring the /Error route is registered or by using the overload with a handler delegate. 4. Run dotnet restore and dotnet build ContosoUniversity.sln; fix all compilation errors. 5. Run dotnet test ContosoUniversity.sln and ensure all tests pass.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded ContosoUniversity from net6.0 to net10.0. Updated TargetFramework in .csproj, upgraded 4 NuGet packages (Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools to 10.0.5, Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design to 10.0.2). Program.cs APIs remained compatible — no code changes needed. Build and tests pass.
